3.x: **Aim:** remove the **disqualification of Indian magistrates** – let Indian **district magistrates and sessions judges** try **European British subjects** in **criminal cases**; Indians and Europeans **on par in criminal jurisdiction**.

The **Indian Association** **backed** the Bill; Indians learnt the value of organised all-India agitation.
